title: ci(test-shard-timings-refresh): push and open the refresh pull request as the fleet App so it runs CI
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2XCfGL2rwSd3BXynetsBjb)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of #13349 (step 2). Step 1, the one-time landing of #13028, is on that pull request.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么：** 每周刷新分片耗时的 workflow，推分支和开 PR 不再用 Actions 自带的 token，改为在 runner 上用 fleet App（`objectstack-fleet[bot]`）临时铸一个 token：只对 objectui 一个仓、只给 contents / pull-requests / workflows 写权限，job 结束即吊销。job 自己的 token 降为只读。文档 `ci-cd-pipeline.md` 同步改写那一节，并在密钥表里登记这对组织级凭据。
- **为什么改：** Actions token 发出的事件 GitHub 不触发 CI，所以刷新 PR 每周都拿不到 CI，只能等人推一下。#13028 从 10-19 等到 10-23，这期间分片不均 1.3–1.8 倍，拖慢每一张 PR。
- **风险与代价（含回滚）：** objectui 的一个 workflow 步骤开始读组织密钥 `OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY`，这是唯一新增的信任面；PR 跑（含 fork）不铸 token、不读密钥。凭据对本仓不可见时，周一那次 run 会红并写明原因，不会悄悄退回旧 token。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。
- **席位意见：**
- **你要做的：** 确认组织密钥 `OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY` 与变量 `OS_FLEET_APP_ID` 对 objectui 可见，并确认 #5397 对 App token 的否决只管 release PR；两点都同意就批准本 PR。

## What changed

`.github/workflows/test-shard-timings-refresh.yml`:

- New step `Check the fleet App credential is visible to this repository`: reads `vars.OS_FLEET_APP_ID != ''` and `secrets.OS_FLEET_PRIVATE_KEY != ''` as booleans (nothing printed) and goes red with a message naming the missing one. It also writes the token's one repository name.
- New step `Mint the fleet App token, narrowed to this repository`: `actions/create-github-app-token@v3` (the same action and credential pair objectstack's `fleet-write.yml` mints with), `repositories` = this repository only, `permission-contents`, `permission-pull-requests` and `permission-workflows` write. The last is there because the weekly force-push moves the branch from last week's base to today's `main`, across whatever workflow files landed in between, which GitHub refuses for an App token without it; the workflow writes no workflow file.
- `Open or update the refresh pull request` now uses that token (`gh auth setup-git` for the push), commits as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, and its pull request body says the PR runs its own CI instead of asking for a human push.
- The job's `GITHUB_TOKEN` drops from `contents: write` + `pull-requests: write` to `contents: read` (plus the existing `actions: read`); checkout no longer persists a credential.
- Both new steps share the existing `github.event_name != 'pull_request'` guard, so a pull-request run (including a fork's) never reads the App secret.
- The header's "The cost it carries, stated" section is rewritten as "Whose identity opens the pull request, and why", carrying the #5397 / #13349 reasoning and the two prohibitions (no personal access token, no fallback to `GITHUB_TOKEN`).

`content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`: the workflow's section, its inventory row, and the secrets table.

No changeset: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` says no released package's source or contract moved.

## Governing text

- The ruling recorded on #13349 (Sales, 2026-10-23, option A), and the two maintainer confirmations it asks for there: the organization credential's visibility to this repository, and #5397's rejection read as scoped to the release pull request.
- objectui#5397 (no personal access token in automation): kept.

## Verification

At head `c543446`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` :: exit 0 (190 files passed, 2 skipped; 5727 tests passed)
- `node scripts/check-action-ref-convention.mjs` :: exit 0 (14 distinct refs, 0 off-convention)
- `pnpm run check:control-bytes` / `check:doc-fences` / `docs:check-links` / `check:new-line-citations` :: exit 0 each
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` :: exit 0 (no changeset owed)
- YAML parses.

Not observable before merge, stated plainly: the mint, the push and the pull request open only on `schedule` / `workflow_dispatch` on `main`. The first proof is a `workflow_dispatch` of this workflow after merge (or the Monday 06:47 UTC run): the refresh PR should show check runs within minutes with no human push. The `workflows: write` need on a force-push across workflow-file changes is GitHub's documented App-token behaviour, not measured here.

## Acceptance notes

- #13028's run on its synced head (`17b3796`, a full-suite PR run) put the 16 test legs at 6.7 to 11.9 minutes of wall clock, about 1.8x. The card's ≤1.2x reading belongs to the first full battery on `main` after #13028 lands; the card session reads it and reports on #13349.
